Description:
Ships: the T-48h email with the holdback experiment attached — the readout that ends the finance argument.

Requirements: REQ-DP1, REQ-D2

Depends on: R1

Blocked by: BLK-01, BLK-05

Test harness:
- Ordering guarantee: send precedes charge by ≥48h (M1)
- Send failure is logged, never silent (F5)
- Holdback assignment is random and recorded at trial start

One email, at least 48 hours before the first charge, stating price and date, with equal keep and one-tap-cancel actions.

Source: PR ¶3 / EFAQ-03

Provenance: [OBSERVED] × 1

Out of scope: reminders for later renewals

Depends on: REQ-D1, BLK-05
Acceptance Criteria:
GIVEN a trial reaching day 12
WHEN  the reminder sends
THEN  it precedes the charge by ≥48h (M1 records the ordering)
AND   a send failure is logged and visible — never silently absorbed (F5)

Description:
A randomized holdback cohort receives no reminder; net revenue at day 60 is compared, reminded vs holdback.

Source: PR ¶7 / IFAQ-01

Provenance: [OBSERVED] × 1, [ASSUMED] × 1 → RESTS ON ASSUMPTION

Out of scope: acting on the result

Depends on: REQ-D1, BLK-01

Conditional on: BLK-01 — finance co-owns the design, or the readout settles nothing
Acceptance Criteria:
GIVEN random assignment at trial start
WHEN  the day-60 readout runs
THEN  it states effect size, confidence interval and cohort sizes — or declares itself underpowered rather than extending silently

Description:

Depends on: R2

Blocked by: BLK-02
